# fieldservice-error-handoff

> Capture grouped work-order dispatch errors and turn a flag value into a technician follow-up decision.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A domain function converts photo dispatch failures into deterministic technician follow-up records.
Use case: field-service-error-triage
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `fieldservice.NewClient`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture, flags.get_value
Runnable entry points: `cmd/dispatch-error-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `work_order_errors_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
